rule.withinMetric: Equal case weight. Credit only for all case criteria supported by actual matching-build evidence and independent review.
rule.overall: Sum(metric weight * passed/total). Missing, blocked, failed, invalid, skipped and not-run earn zero. Incomplete score is capped below 100.
rule.completion: Every metric must be 100; an aggregate average cannot waive a case. Platform limits and missing human input remain open.
rule.meaning: Zero evidence-backed score is not a conclusion that the product has zero functionality.

resolvedSourceAndUIFindings.title: Message-only cleanup also removed startup and shutdown cleanup of stale native controls

resolution.assessment: Startup removes prior-process delivered and pending notifications. The new shutdown method clears message entries and explicitly removes tracked HFP and mirrored IDs, resets call state, and is called from applicationWillTerminate after calling.shutdown. Ordinary message expiry/eviction stays scoped to message IDs. Both reported source paths are addressed.

resolvedSourceAndUIFindings.title: Mac validation accepts Unicode text exceeding the existing Android limit before consuming context

resolution.assessment: Reply preflight and generic payload string limits use utf16.count, matching Android String.length. The 2,001-emoji case now rejects before messages.takeReply at line 144. Neither validation path changes the original text.
resolution.unicodeTests: Completed source reviewed at ReplyRouterTests.swift:85-114; both cases pass in parent rerun-3 log:489. Native interaction/integration remains separate.

resolvedSourceAndUIFindings.title: Expired Answer can start an additional native audio side effect after a stuck call returns

resolution.assessment: WorkTracker.permitsNextStep requires the same executing operation with neither quarantine nor sticky invalidation. cancel/expire set invalidation under the worker lock. Answer rechecks immediately after acceptCall returns, before audio transfer, and also requires the original call context. The worker wrapper rejects stopping. Mute getter/setter and connection substeps have corresponding guards. An expired/cancelled blocked first call therefore cannot authorize the reported subsequent side effect. Permanent executing-timeout quarantine remains.

regressionSource.assessment: New production-used WorkTracker test asserts next-step denial for both cancel and expire, before and after return; release remains forbidden for expired work. This is helper-source coverage plus independently traced worker use, not executed native continuation proof.
